title: Manila RTC issues 4th arrest warrant vs Ang

blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — A fourth warrant of arrest has been issued against gambling tycoon Charlie “Atong” Ang, who is facing nonbailable charges of kidnapping and serious illegal detention over the disappearance of at least 34 “sabungeros” or cockfight enthusiasts from 2021 to 2022.
